facts.name: Policy Identification Number
facts.sentence: The policy number is SCL-BSS-2026-6129.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is January 28, 2026.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Policy Structure
facts.sentence: The policy form is Second-to-Die Whole Life.

facts.name: First Insured Identified
facts.sentence: The first insured is Michael Andrew Salter.

facts.name: Birth Date of First Insured
facts.sentence: Michael Andrew Salter was born on August 8, 1955.

facts.name: Insured Age Confirmation
facts.sentence: Michael Andrew Salter is 70 years old.

facts.name: Standard Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Michael Andrew Salter’s risk class is Standard.

facts.name: Second Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The second insured is Patricia Helen Salter.

facts.name: Birthdate of Patricia Salter
facts.sentence: Patricia Helen Salter was born on February 21, 1959.

facts.name: Age of Patricia Salter
facts.sentence: Patricia Helen Salter is 67 years old.

facts.name: Standard Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Patricia Helen Salter’s risk class is Standard.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identification
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Salter Manufacturing Holdings, Inc.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The beneficiary is Salter Manufacturing Holdings, Inc.

facts.name: Face Amount: $2.75M
facts.sentence: The face amount of the policy is $2,750,000.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium for the policy is $47,600.

facts.name: Quarterly Premium Option
facts.sentence: The premium mode is quarterly, available upon request.

facts.name: Survivorship Coverage for Shareholders
facts.sentence: This policy insures two key shareholder spouses on a survivorship whole life basis.

facts.name: Second Death Payout Condition
facts.sentence: The death benefit under this policy becomes payable only upon the death of the second insured.

facts.name: No Payout at First Death
facts.sentence: No proceeds are payable at the time of the first insured’s death.

facts.name: Survival After First Death
facts.sentence: The policy remains in force after the first death.

facts.name: Corporate Succession Support
facts.sentence: This policy is intended to support corporate succession.

facts.name: Deferred Compensation Support
facts.sentence: This policy is intended to support deferred compensation reimbursement.

facts.name: Liquidity Planning Support
facts.sentence: This policy is intended to support liquidity planning.

facts.name: Second Death Payout Condition
facts.sentence: At the second death, we will pay the face amount less any policy debt.

facts.name: Proceeds Use: Redemption Obligations
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may apply all or part of the proceeds toward redemption obligations.

facts.name: Proceeds Use: Deferred Compensation
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may apply all or part of the proceeds toward deferred compensation liabilities.

facts.name: Proceeds Use – Reserve Funding
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may apply all or part of the proceeds toward reserve funding.

facts.name: Proceeds Use Flexibility
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may apply all or part of the proceeds toward general corporate purposes.

facts.name: No Post-Payout Monitoring
facts.sentence: We do not monitor the beneficiary's actual use of proceeds once paid.

facts.name: Proof of Both Deaths Required
facts.sentence: Proof of both deaths may be required.

facts.name: Proof of Corporate Authority Required
facts.sentence: Corporate authority to receive proceeds may be required.

facts.name: Executive Trust Assignment
facts.sentence: If the Executive Bonus Continuation Option is elected and shown in the schedule, the corporate owner may assign ownership to a designated executive trust.

facts.name: Ownership Assignment Post-Retirement
facts.sentence: The assignment of ownership can occur after the retirement of both insureds.

facts.name: Executive Bonus Election
facts.sentence: The Executive Bonus Continuation Option may be elected and displayed in the schedule.

facts.name: Executive Trust Assignment Right
facts.sentence: If the Executive Bonus Continuation Option is elected and shown in the schedule, the corporate owner may assign ownership to a designated executive trust.

facts.name: Post-Retirement Ownership Assignment
facts.sentence: Ownership assignment under the Executive Bonus Continuation Option occurs after the retirement of both insureds.

facts.name: Written Assignment Requirement
facts.sentence: Any assignment of ownership under the Executive Bonus Continuation Option must be in writing.

facts.name: Ownership Assignment Recording Requirement
facts.sentence: Any assignment of ownership under the Executive Bonus Continuation Option must be recorded by the insurer.

facts.name: Recorded Assignment Effect
facts.sentence: A recorded assignment changes future owner rights.

facts.name: Assignment Does Not Change Insureds
facts.sentence: A recorded assignment does not change the insureds listed on the policy.

facts.name: Assignment Preserves Survivorship
facts.sentence: A recorded assignment does not alter the survivorship nature of the policy.

facts.name: Life-Time Premium Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums under this policy are payable for life unless the policy becomes reduced paid-up.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period for monthly premium payments is 31 days.

facts.name: Grace Period for Annual Payments
facts.sentence: The grace period for annual premium payments is 62 days.

facts.name: Premium Obligations After First Death
facts.sentence: If the first insured dies, premium obligations continue.

facts.name: Guaranteed Cash Value Accumulation
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash value accumulates under this policy.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timing
facts.sentence: Loans are available after the second policy year.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is 90% of the net cash surrender value.

facts.name: Variable Loan Rate Set
facts.sentence: The variable loan rate is currently 5.25%.

facts.name: Owner Surrender Right
facts.sentence: The owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Election
facts.sentence: The owner may elect reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: No Partial Withdrawals Allowed
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals are not permitted under this policy.

facts.name: Insured Purchase Upon Asset Sale
facts.sentence: If the corporate owner sells substantially all of its assets, the surviving insured may apply to purchase the policy from the owner.

facts.name: Corporate Sale Purchase Right
facts.sentence: If the corporate owner sells substantially all of its assets, a trust for the surviving insured may apply to purchase the policy from the owner.

facts.name: Insurer Approval Discretion
facts.sentence: The insurer is not obligated to approve any transfer request under Article VI.

facts.name: Insurer Not Obligated to Value Transfer
facts.sentence: The insurer is not obligated to provide a valuation for any transfer under Article VI.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer Compliance
facts.sentence: Any ownership transfer under Article VI must comply with applicable laws.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer Tax Compliance
facts.sentence: Any ownership transfer under Article VI must comply with tax rules.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer Requirements
facts.sentence: Any ownership transfer under Article VI must meet the insurer's administrative requirements.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Limitation
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within two years after the policy issue date, the insurer’s liability is limited to premiums paid minus debt.

facts.name: Contestability Period Duration
facts.sentence: The contestability period for this policy begins on the issue date and lasts for two years.

facts.name: No Military Service Exclusion
facts.sentence: This policy contains no military service exclusion.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Policy Maturity
facts.sentence: If both insureds die in the same incident and no order of death can be established, the policy will be treated as matured.

facts.name: Common Disaster Maturity
facts.sentence: The policy will be treated as matured when satisfactory proof of simultaneous deaths is received.

facts.name: Corporate Beneficiary Change Right
facts.sentence: The corporate owner may change beneficiaries under this policy.

facts.name: Corporate Borrowing Rights
facts.sentence: The corporate owner may borrow against the policy.

facts.name: Corporate Ownership Assignment
facts.sentence: The corporate owner may assign ownership of the policy.

facts.name: Corporate Owner Surrender Right
facts.sentence: The corporate owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Corporate Owner Nonforfeiture Rights
facts.sentence: The corporate owner may elect nonforfeiture options.

facts.name: Corporate Act Authorization
facts.sentence: Any corporate act related to the policy must be authorized by an officer of the corporation.

facts.name: Corporate Act Authorization Requirement
facts.sentence: Any corporate act related to the policy must be authorized by another person acceptable to the insurer.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: This policy may be canceled within 15 days after delivery.

facts.name: Free Look Period Duration
facts.sentence: The free look period ends 15 days after delivery.

facts.name: Insured Nonforfeiture Rights
facts.sentence: An insured party may elect nonforfeiture options.

facts.name: Corporate Act Authorization
facts.sentence: Any corporate act must be authorized by an officer.

facts.name: Corporate Act Authorization
facts.sentence: Any corporate act must be authorized by another person acceptable to the insurer.

facts.name: Free look cancellation rights
facts.sentence: This policy may be cancelled within 15 days after delivery.

facts.name: Refund on Early Cancellation
facts.sentence: A refund of premiums paid shall be issued upon cancellation of this policy within 15 days after delivery.

fact_fact.label: limits
fact_fact.description: The free look period, ending 15 days after delivery as stated in fact_sentence_2, provides the basis for the cancellation rights mentioned in fact_sentence_1.

fact_fact.label: depends on

fact_fact.label: depends on

fact_fact.label: suppresses

fact_fact.label: conditional on

fact_fact.label: depends on

fact_fact.label: extends

fact_fact.label: enables

facts.name: Policy Identification Number
facts.sentence: The policy number is NBA-CLS-2026-2814.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is February 19, 2026.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Policy Type
facts.sentence: The policy form is Second-to-Die Whole Life.

facts.name: First Insured Identified
facts.sentence: The first insured is Eleanor Jean Whitmore.

facts.name: Eleanor Whitmore's Birth Date
facts.sentence: The birth date of Eleanor Jean Whitmore is April 30, 1954.

facts.name: Age of First Insured
facts.sentence: The age of Eleanor Jean Whitmore at issue is 71.

facts.name: Preferred Risk Classification
facts.sentence: The risk class of Eleanor Jean Whitmore is Preferred.

facts.name: Second Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The second insured is Thomas Reed Whitmore.

facts.name: Thomas Whitmore Birth Date
facts.sentence: The birth date of Thomas Reed Whitmore is December 12, 1953.

facts.name: Age of Second Insured
facts.sentence: The age of Thomas Reed Whitmore at issue is 72.

facts.name: Preferred Risk Classification
facts.sentence: The risk class of Thomas Reed Whitmore is Preferred.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identification
facts.sentence: The policy owner is the Whitmore Charitable Planning Trust.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is the City Arts Endowment Fund.

facts.name: Secondary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The secondary beneficiary is the Whitmore Charitable Planning Trust.

facts.name: Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: The death benefit amount is $1,250,000.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium amount is $27,900.

facts.name: Reduce Premium Dividend Option
facts.sentence: At issue, the dividend option selected is reduce premium.

facts.name: Dual-Life Insurance Coverage
facts.sentence: This policy insures two lives.

facts.name: Second Death Payout Rule
facts.sentence: The policy pays the death benefit at second death only.

facts.name: No Claim at First Death
facts.sentence: If one insured dies, no death claim is payable.

facts.name: Survival Continuation Clause
facts.sentence: After the death of one insured, the policy continues on the surviving life.

facts.name: Charitable Legacy Purpose
facts.sentence: This policy is intended to support charitable legacy planning.

facts.name: Charitable Assignment Right
facts.sentence: After the 10th policy year, the owner may irrevocably assign all or a portion of the policy proceeds to one or more qualified charitable organizations.

facts.name: Charitable Assignment Requirement
facts.sentence: To effect an assignment, the owner must file an endorsement acceptable to New Beacon Assurance.

facts.name: Insurer Not Responsible for Charity Qualification
facts.sentence: New Beacon Assurance is not required to determine whether an organization is a qualified charity under tax law.

facts.name: Charity Unavailability Payout Rule
facts.sentence: If a named charity cannot accept the proceeds, payment will be made to the secondary beneficiary.

facts.name: Secondary Beneficiary Payment Rule
facts.sentence: Payment to the secondary beneficiary occurs unless the owner has filed a replacement designation.

facts.name: Death Benefit Settlement Terms
facts.sentence: We will pay the death benefit less any outstanding policy debt at second death.

facts.name: Beneficiary Payout Options
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may elect either a lump sum or a fixed-period settlement.

facts.name: Replacement Designation Filed
facts.sentence: A replacement designation was filed.

facts.name: Second Death Payout Condition
facts.sentence: The insurer will pay the death benefit minus policy debt at second death.

facts.name: Lump Sum Settlement Option
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may choose a lump sum settlement option.

facts.name: Fixed-Period Settlement Option
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may choose a fixed-period settlement option.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Verification
facts.sentence: For charitable beneficiaries, the insurer may require evidence of legal existence.

facts.name: Charitable Beneficiary Verification
facts.sentence: For charitable beneficiaries, the insurer may require evidence of authority to receive proceeds.

facts.name: Annual Premium Payment Obligation
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable annually for life.

facts.name: Nonforfeiture Election Termination
facts.sentence: Premium payments may terminate early due to a nonforfeiture election.

facts.name: Early termination via surrender
facts.sentence: Premium payments may terminate early due to surrender.

facts.name: Participating Policy Feature
facts.sentence: This is a participating policy.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Dividends
facts.sentence: Dividends are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Cash Dividend Option
facts.sentence: One dividend option is receiving dividends in cash.

facts.name: Dividend Premium Reduction
facts.sentence: One dividend option is using dividends to reduce future premiums.

facts.name: Accumulating Dividends at Interest
facts.sentence: One dividend option is accumulating dividends at interest.

facts.name: Paid-Up Additions Option
facts.sentence: One dividend option is purchasing paid-up additions.

facts.name: Premium Obligations After First Death
facts.sentence: If the first insured dies, premium obligations continue.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period for premium payment is 61 days.

facts.name: Cash Value Accumulation
facts.sentence: Guaranteed cash values accumulate under the policy.

facts.name: Loan Access Timing
facts.sentence: Loans may be taken after one full policy year.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The fixed loan interest rate is 5.0%.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Value Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan value is 90% of the current loan value available.

facts.name: Loan Impact on Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Policy loans reduce the death benefit.

facts.name: Loans Reduce Cash Surrender Value
facts.sentence: Policy loans reduce the cash surrender value.

facts.name: Memorial Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: If elected and listed in the schedule, a memorial benefit of $25,000 may be paid at first death.

facts.name: Memorial Benefit Use
facts.sentence: The memorial benefit may be used for charitable events.

facts.name: Memorial Benefit Use Case
facts.sentence: The memorial benefit may be used for donor recognition.

facts.name: Memorial Benefit Use
facts.sentence: The memorial benefit may be used for memorial expenses.

facts.name: Memorial Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: Any memorial benefit paid under this endorsement reduces the amount payable at second death.

facts.name: Memorial Benefit Termination
facts.sentence: The Memorial Benefit Endorsement terminates at first death.

facts.name: Suicide Clause – First Two Years
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within two years after issue, liability is limited to premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Liability Limit
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within two years after issue, liability is reduced by indebtedness.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: The policy is contestable for two years after issue.

facts.name: Contestability for Misrepresentation
facts.sentence: Contestability applies for material misrepresentation.

facts.name: No Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: No travel exclusion applies to the policy.

facts.name: No Aviation Exclusion
facts.sentence: No aviation exclusion applies to the policy.

facts.name: Common Disaster Payment Rule
facts.sentence: If both insureds die in a common event and the order of death cannot be determined, the policy pays as a matured second-death claim.

facts.name: Trustee-only Ownership Rights
facts.sentence: Owner rights are exercisable only by the trustee.

facts.name: Owner Beneficiary Change Right
facts.sentence: The owner may change beneficiaries.

facts.name: Owner Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner may assign the policy.

facts.name: Policy Loan Rights
facts.sentence: The owner may take policy loans.

facts.name: Owner Surrender Right
facts.sentence: The owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Owner Rights Subject to Law
facts.sentence: Owner rights are subject to applicable law.

facts.name: Free Look Period Return
facts.sentence: The policy may be returned during the free look period.

facts.sentence: Owner rights are exercisable only by the trustee.

facts.name: Owner Can Change Beneficiaries

facts.sentence: The owner may assign the policy.

facts.name: Owner borrowing rights

facts.sentence: Actions taken by the owner are subject to law.

facts.name: Issued by North Valley Fidelity
facts.sentence: The estate equalization survivorship whole life policy was issued by North Valley Fidelity.

facts.name: Policy Identification Number
facts.sentence: The policy number is NVF-EES-2026-1493.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is March 5, 2026.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Policy Type
facts.sentence: The policy form is Second-to-Die Whole Life.

facts.name: First Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The first insured under the policy is Harold James Mercer.

facts.name: Date of Birth: Harold Mercer
facts.sentence: Harold James Mercer’s date of birth is July 1, 1956.

facts.name: Insured Age at Issuance
facts.sentence: Harold James Mercer is 69 years old at the time of issuance.

facts.name: Standard Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Harold James Mercer is classified as Standard risk class.

facts.name: Second Insured Identification
facts.sentence: The second insured under the policy is Judith Ann Mercer.

facts.name: Judith Ann Mercer Birthdate
facts.sentence: Judith Ann Mercer’s date of birth is September 14, 1957.

facts.name: Insured Age at Issuance
facts.sentence: Judith Ann Mercer is 68 years old at the time of issuance.

facts.name: Standard Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Judith Ann Mercer is classified as Standard risk class.

facts.name: Co-Owner Inclusion
facts.sentence: The policy owner includes Harold James Mercer.

facts.name: Co-Owner Inclusion
facts.sentence: The policy owner includes Judith Ann Mercer.

facts.name: Co-Ownership Inclusion
facts.sentence: The policy owner includes Mercer Ranch LLC.

facts.name: Co-Ownership Structure
facts.sentence: Harold James Mercer, Judith Ann Mercer, and Mercer Ranch LLC are co-owners of the policy.

facts.name: Ownership Agreement Determination
facts.sentence: Co-ownership percentages are determined by the ownership agreement filed with North Valley Fidelity.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The beneficiary of the policy is Mercer Equalization Trust.

facts.name: Face Amount: $3.6M
facts.sentence: The face amount of the policy is $3,600,000.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium for the policy is $63,400.

facts.name: Premium Payment Options
facts.sentence: The premium arrangement allows for either annual or semiannual payments.

facts.name: Survivorship Coverage Definition
facts.sentence: Article I of the policy establishes survivorship coverage.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Coverage
facts.sentence: This policy provides whole life coverage on a second-to-die basis.

facts.name: Survivorship Benefit Trigger
facts.sentence: The death benefit is payable only after both insureds have died.

facts.name: Survivorship Policy Continuity
facts.sentence: If one insured dies, the policy remains in force.

facts.name: Estate Inheritance Equalization
facts.sentence: This policy is intended to assist in equalizing inheritances among beneficiaries who receive operating and non-operating assets.

facts.name: Co-Owner Administration Rules
facts.sentence: Article II governs co-owner administration.

facts.name: Co-Owner Consent Requirement
facts.sentence: All co-owners must sign any request to change beneficiaries.

facts.name: Co-Owner Consent for Ownership Transfer
facts.sentence: All co-owners must sign any request to assign ownership.

facts.name: Co-Owner Consent for Surrender
facts.sentence: All co-owners must sign any request to surrender the policy.

facts.name: Co-Owner Consent for Nonforfeiture Option
facts.sentence: All co-owners must sign any request to elect a nonforfeiture option.

facts.name: Co-Owner Consent for Face Amount Change
facts.sentence: All co-owners must sign any request to change the face amount.

facts.name: Single Co-Owner Premium Authorization
facts.sentence: Any single co-owner may authorize payment of the premium.

facts.name: Post-Death Ownership Transfer
facts.sentence: After the first death, a deceased co-owner's rights pass according to the ownership agreement.

facts.name: Post-Death Ownership Transfer
facts.sentence: After the first death, a deceased co-owner's rights pass according to applicable law.

facts.name: Co-Owner Dispute Resolution
facts.sentence: North Valley Fidelity may rely on a co-owner certification if there is a dispute among owners.

facts.name: Court Order Reliance in Disputes
facts.sentence: North Valley Fidelity may rely on a court order if there is a dispute among owners.

facts.name: Co-Owner Rights Transfer
facts.sentence: Co-owner's rights pass according to the ownership agreement.

facts.name: Co-Owner Rights Transfer
facts.sentence: Co-owner's rights pass according to applicable law.

facts.name: Co-owner Dispute Resolution
facts.sentence: The insurer may rely on a co-owner certification during disputes among owners.

facts.name: Court Order in Ownership Disputes
facts.sentence: The insurer may rely on a court order during disputes among owners.

facts.name: Second Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: The insurer will pay the face amount plus any paid-up additions minus policy debt upon second death.

facts.name: Trust Beneficiary Verification
facts.sentence: If the beneficiary is a trust, the insurer may require trust certification.

facts.name: Trust Beneficiary Verification
facts.sentence: If the beneficiary is a trust, the insurer may require tax identification information.

facts.name: Lump Sum Settlement Option
facts.sentence: Settlement options include lump sum payment.

facts.name: Fixed Installment Settlement
facts.sentence: Settlement options include fixed installment payments.

facts.name: Participating Policy Status
facts.sentence: This policy is a participating policy.

facts.name: Dividend Allocation Default
facts.sentence: Unless modified by the owner, dividends will purchase paid-up additions.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Dividends
facts.sentence: Dividends are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Life Premium Obligation
facts.sentence: Premiums are due for life unless the policy becomes reduced paid-up.

facts.name: Premiums Due Until Death
facts.sentence: Premiums are due for life unless the policy is fully supported by dividends and internal values.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Policy Support
facts.sentence: Support of the policy by dividends and internal values is not guaranteed.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period is 61 days.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timing
facts.sentence: Loans are available after policy year 1.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is 90% of net cash surrender value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The fixed loan interest rate is 5.25%.

facts.name: No Partial Withdrawals Allowed
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals are not permitted.

facts.name: Estate Liquidity Advance Election
facts.sentence: An estate liquidity advance option may be elected at issue.

facts.name: Estate Liquidity Advance Option
facts.sentence: The owner may request an advance of up to 10% of the face amount at first death.

facts.name: Estate Liquidity Advance Use
facts.sentence: The advance may be used for tax, legal, or appraisal expenses related to estate administration.

facts.name: Advance Reduces Second Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Any amount advanced under Article VI reduces the amount payable at second death.

facts.name: Proof of First Death Required
facts.sentence: Proof of first death is required for an advance under Article VI.

facts.name: Proof of Need Required
facts.sentence: Evidence of need satisfactory to the insurer is required for an advance under Article VI.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Limitation
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within two years after issue, liability is limited to premiums paid minus indebtedness.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: The policy is contestable for two years after issue.

facts.name: No Residence Exclusion Applies
facts.sentence: No residence exclusion applies to the policy.

facts.name: No Foreign Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: No foreign travel exclusion applies to the policy.

facts.name: Survivorship Uncertainty Claim Rule
facts.sentence: If both insureds die and survivorship cannot be determined, the claim will be processed as a second-death claim.

facts.name: Second Death Within 60 Days
facts.sentence: If the second insured dies within 60 days after the first insured’s death, only one death benefit is payable.

facts.name: Policy Assignment Rights
facts.sentence: Assignment of the policy is allowed.

facts.name: Second Death Benefit Rule
facts.sentence: If the second insured dies within 60 days after the first, only one death benefit is payable.

facts.name: Second-Death Claim Processing
facts.sentence: Once it is determined who survived, the claim will be processed as a second-death claim.

facts.name: Assignment Signing Requirement
facts.sentence: Any assignment must be signed by all persons whose consent is required under Article II.

facts.name: Assignment Liability Disclaimer
facts.sentence: We are not responsible for the effect of any assignment on ownership percentages.

facts.name: Tax Treatment Disclaimer
facts.sentence: We are not responsible for the effect of any assignment on tax treatment.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The owner may cancel this policy within 25 days after receipt.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Policy
facts.sentence: A refund of premiums paid will be issued if the policy is cancelled within 25 days after receipt.

facts.name: Policy Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is PAM-FSI-2026-4238.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is February 11, 2026.

facts.name: Second-to-Die Policy Structure
facts.sentence: The policy form is Second-to-Die Whole Life.

facts.name: First Insured: Kenneth Donnelly
facts.sentence: The first insured is Kenneth Paul Donnelly.

facts.name: Kenneth Donnelly Birthdate
facts.sentence: Kenneth Paul Donnelly's date of birth is March 8, 1958.

facts.name: Age of First Insured
facts.sentence: Kenneth Paul Donnelly is 68 years old.

facts.name: Preferred Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Kenneth Paul Donnelly’s risk class is Preferred.

facts.name: Second Insured: Rebecca Anne Donnelly
facts.sentence: The second insured is Rebecca Anne Donnelly.

facts.name: Date of Birth: Rebecca Anne Donnelly
facts.sentence: Rebecca Anne Donnelly's date of birth is January 17, 1961.

facts.name: Age of Joint Insured
facts.sentence: Rebecca Anne Donnelly is 65 years old.

facts.name: Preferred Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Rebecca Anne Donnelly’s risk class is Preferred.

facts.name: Initial Policy Owner
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Rebecca Anne Donnelly as the initial owner.

facts.name: Succession to Trust After First Death
facts.sentence: Successor ownership transfers to the Donnelly Family Trust upon the first death.

facts.name: Trust Transfer Condition
facts.sentence: Transfer to the Donnelly Family Trust occurs only if a trust assignment is filed before the first death.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The beneficiary of the policy is the Donnelly Family Trust.

facts.name: Face Amount: $2.1M
facts.sentence: The face amount of the policy is $2,100,000.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium for the policy is $36,200.

facts.name: Family Survivor Income Option
facts.sentence: The special settlement feature of the policy is the Family Survivor Income Option.

facts.name: Second Death Benefit Trigger
facts.sentence: This policy pays a death benefit only at second death.

facts.name: No Claim at First Death
facts.sentence: If one insured dies, no death claim is payable.

facts.name: Policy Continues After First Death
facts.sentence: After one insured dies, the policy remains in force.

facts.name: Family Support Purpose
facts.sentence: This policy is intended for family support purposes.

facts.name: Inheritance Planning Purpose
facts.sentence: This policy is intended for inheritance planning purposes.

facts.name: Death Benefit at Second Death
facts.sentence: Under Article I – Coverage, Section 1.1, the policy pays a death benefit only at second death.

facts.name: No Benefit on First Death
facts.sentence: Under Article I – Coverage, Section 1.2, if one insured dies, no death claim is payable.

facts.name: Family Support & Inheritance Planning
facts.sentence: Under Article I – Coverage, Section 1.3, the policy is intended for family support and inheritance planning.

facts.name: Initial Lump Sum Election
facts.sentence: Under Article II – Family Survivor Income Option, Section 2.1, the beneficiary may elect an initial lump sum equal to 20% of the net death benefit.

facts.name: Monthly Income Options Duration
facts.sentence: Under Article II – Family Survivor Income Option, Section 2.1, the beneficiary may receive monthly income payments over 10, 15, or 20 years.

facts.name: Monthly Income Determination
facts.sentence: Under Article II – Family Survivor Income Option, Section 2.2, the amount of monthly income depends on the net death benefit.

facts.name: Monthly Income Determination
facts.sentence: Under Article II – Family Survivor Income Option, Section 2.2, the amount of monthly income depends on the settlement period selected.

facts.name: Monthly Income Determination
facts.sentence: Under Article II – Family Survivor Income Option, Section 2.2, the amount of monthly income depends on the interest rate applicable under the company’s settlement option rules then in effect.

facts.name: Irreversible Settlement Option
facts.sentence: Under Article II – Family Survivor Income Option, Section 2.3, once monthly income payments begin, the settlement option cannot be changed.

facts.name: Settlement Change Limitation
facts.sentence: Under Article II – Family Survivor Income Option, Section 2.3, any change to the settlement option is allowed only as permitted by law.

facts.name: Net Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: Under Article III – Death Benefit, Section 3.1, the net death benefit equals the face amount plus paid-up additions.

facts.name: Settlement Option Lock-in
facts.sentence: Once monthly income payments begin, the settlement option may not be changed.

facts.name: Settlement Option Change Restriction
facts.sentence: The settlement option may only be changed if permitted by law.

facts.name: Net Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The net death benefit equals the face amount plus paid-up additions, if any.

facts.name: Incorrect Death Benefit Formula
facts.sentence: The net death benefit minus policy debt equals the net death benefit.

facts.name: Proof of Dual Deaths Required
facts.sentence: Proof of both deaths is required.

facts.name: Beneficiary Documentation Required
facts.sentence: Beneficiary documentation is required.

facts.name: Trust Beneficiary Payment
facts.sentence: If a trust is the beneficiary, payment may be made to the trustee.

facts.name: Trust Payment Terms
facts.sentence: Payment to the trustee occurs under the terms of the trust certification furnished to us.

facts.name: Participating Policy Status
facts.sentence: This is a participating policy.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Dividends
facts.sentence: Dividends are not guaranteed.

facts.name: Dividend Accumulation Default
facts.sentence: Unless the owner elects otherwise, dividends will accumulate at interest.

facts.name: Lifetime Premium Payments
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable for life.

facts.name: Life-long premium obligation
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable for life unless the policy is surrendered.

facts.name: Life-long premium obligation
facts.sentence: Premiums are payable for life unless the policy is reduced paid-up.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period is 60 days.

facts.name: Loan Availability Timeline
facts.sentence: Loans are available after one policy year.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is 90% of available loan value.

facts.name: Fixed Loan Interest Rate
facts.sentence: The fixed loan interest rate is 5.0%.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Value Availability
facts.sentence: Cash surrender value is available as shown in the schedule.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Value Availability
facts.sentence: Reduced paid-up value is available as shown in the schedule.

facts.name: No Partial Withdrawals Allowed
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals are not permitted.

facts.name: First-Death Conversion Option
facts.sentence: After first death, the owner may elect within 180 days to convert this policy administratively to a premium-offset status.

facts.name: Premium-Offset Conversion Condition
facts.sentence: Conversion to premium-offset status is contingent on availability of dividends and cash values.

facts.name: Premium-Offset Availability Condition
facts.sentence: Availability of premium-offset status depends on current rules at the time of election.

facts.name: Premium-Offset Availability Uncertainty
facts.sentence: We do not guarantee that premium-offset status will be available.

facts.name: Premium-Offset Growth Impact
facts.sentence: Election of premium-offset status may reduce future policy growth.

facts.name: Suicide Clause – First Two Years
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within two years after issue, liability is limited to premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Liability
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within two years after issue, liability is limited to premiums paid less indebtedness.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: The policy is contestable for material misrepresentation during the first two years after issue.

facts.name: Hazardous Hobby Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no hazardous hobby exclusion unless specifically added by endorsement.

facts.name: Simultaneous Death Payout Rule
facts.sentence: If both insureds die in the same occurrence and the order of death cannot be established, the policy will be treated as payable at second death.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The owner may cancel this policy within 30 days after receipt.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Policy
facts.sentence: A full refund of premium paid is given upon cancellation within 30 days after receipt.

facts.name: Second Death Payout
facts.sentence: Benefits under the policy are payable upon the second death.

facts.name: Policy Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy has the right to cancel the policy within 30 days after receiving it.

facts.name: Free Look Refund Right
facts.sentence: If the policy is canceled within 30 days of receipt, the owner is entitled to a full refund of the premium paid.

facts.sentence: This policy is marketed for asset protection purposes.

facts.name: Legacy Transfer Strategy
facts.sentence: This policy is marketed for legacy transfer strategies.

facts.name: Guaranteed Premium Period
facts.sentence: The annual premium is guaranteed for the first 12 policy years.

facts.name: Premium Continuation After Year 12
facts.sentence: Beginning in policy year 13, the owner may continue paying premiums at the current rate.

facts.name: Premium Increase Flexibility Post-Guarantee
facts.sentence: Beginning in policy year 13, the owner may increase premiums up to the maximum premium stated in the schedule.

facts.name: Prepayment of Annual Premiums
facts.sentence: Subject to company rules, the owner may prepay up to 3 annual premiums in advance.

facts.name: Premium Prepayment Limits
facts.sentence: Prepayment of premiums must not violate applicable tax qualification limits.

facts.name: Premium Continuity After First Death
facts.sentence: If the first insured dies, the premium schedule continues unchanged.

facts.name: Tax Compliance Requirement
facts.sentence: Applicable tax qualification limits must not be violated.

facts.name: Premium Continuation After First Death
facts.sentence: If the first insured dies, the premium schedule continues.

facts.name: Second Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: The insurer will pay the face amount minus policy debt and unpaid loan interest upon the second death.

facts.name: Trust Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: The insurer may require trust authority documents prior to making a death benefit payment.

facts.name: Tax ID Requirement Before Payout
facts.sentence: The insurer may require taxpayer identification information prior to making a death benefit payment.

facts.name: Lump Sum Settlement Option
facts.sentence: Settlement options include lump sum payments when permitted.

facts.name: Fixed Installment Settlement
facts.sentence: Settlement options include fixed installment payments when permitted.

facts.name: Retained-Asset Account Option
facts.sentence: Settlement options include a retained-asset account when permitted.

facts.name: Loan Availability After 24 Months
facts.sentence: Loans are available after 24 months of the policy being in force.

facts.name: Maximum Loan Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum loan amount is 92% of the net surrender value.

facts.name: Variable Loan Rate
facts.sentence: The variable loan rate is currently 5.65%.

facts.name: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance Option
facts.sentence: The owner may elect reduced paid-up insurance.

facts.name: Cash Surrender Option
facts.sentence: The owner may elect cash surrender.

facts.name: No Partial Withdrawals Allowed
facts.sentence: Partial withdrawals are not permitted.

facts.name: Trust Authority Reliance
facts.sentence: If the owner is a trust established for asset protection planning, the insurer may rely on any certification of trustee authority.

facts.name: Trust Validation Exemption
facts.sentence: The insurer is not required to investigate the validity of a trust if the owner is a trust formed for asset protection planning.

facts.name: No Creditor Protection Guarantee
facts.sentence: The insurer does not guarantee creditor protection for any policy interest.

facts.name: No Spendthrift Guarantee
facts.sentence: The insurer does not guarantee a spendthrift effect for any policy interest.

facts.name: No Bankruptcy Guarantee
facts.sentence: The insurer does not guarantee bankruptcy treatment for any policy interest.

facts.name: Owner Legal Advice Responsibility
facts.sentence: The owner is responsible for obtaining independent legal advice regarding the policy.

facts.name: Replacement Review Window
facts.sentence: If this policy replaced another survivorship policy, the owner may request an administrative review within 60 days after issuance.

facts.name: Administrative Review for Premium Credits
facts.sentence: The administrative review pertains to discrepancies in applied premium credits disclosed during replacement.

facts.name: Endorsement Benefit Limitation
facts.sentence: This endorsement does not increase the death benefit.

facts.name: Premium Credit Application
facts.sentence: Any premium credit granted under this endorsement will be added to the policy value as determined by the insurer.

facts.name: Suicide Death Benefit Limitation
facts.sentence: If either insured dies by suicide within two years after issue, liability is limited to premiums paid minus debt.

facts.name: Contestability Period Duration
facts.sentence: The contestability period is two years after issue.

facts.name: No Occupational Exclusion
facts.sentence: No occupational exclusion applies to the policy.

facts.name: No Foreign Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: No foreign travel exclusion applies to the policy.

facts.name: No Terrorism Exclusion
facts.sentence: No terrorism exclusion applies to the policy.

facts.name: Common Disaster Claim Processing
facts.sentence: If both insureds die in the same occurrence and the order of death cannot be determined, the claim will be processed as a second-death benefit claim.

facts.name: Policy Assignment Procedure
facts.sentence: The owner may assign the policy through a written instrument recorded by the insurer.

facts.name: Collateral Assignment Rights
facts.sentence: The owner may collateralize the policy through a written instrument recorded by the insurer.

facts.name: Assignment Recording Requirement
facts.sentence: The insurer is not bound by any assignment until the assignment is recorded.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The owner may cancel this policy within the free look period.

facts.name: Policy Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner has the right to assign the policy.

facts.name: Collateral Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner may collateralize the assignment of the policy.

facts.name: Assignment Requires Written Instrument
facts.sentence: An assignment of the policy requires a written instrument.

facts.name: Assignment Requires Recording
facts.sentence: A written instrument used to assign the policy must be recorded by the insurer.

facts.name: Assignment Binding Condition
facts.sentence: The insurer is not bound by any assignment of the policy until the assignment is recorded.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: The owner may cancel this policy within 30 days after delivery.

facts.name: Free Look Cancellation Right
facts.sentence: If the owner cancels the policy within 30 days after delivery, they are entitled to a refund.

facts.name: Refund Equals Premium Paid
facts.sentence: The refund amount equals the total premium paid.
